# A.T.F.O. (AI Tools For Owners): every tool stack

> AI Tools For Owners (A.T.F.O.) is a free tool that recommends AI and automation tool stacks, with setup steps, for small business owners.

Source: https://aitoolsforowners.com . Prices last checked 2026-10-14. Prices are starting prices and change; check each tool's official site. Some links on the site are affiliate links.

## Best AI tools for following up with leads
URL: https://aitoolsforowners.com/best-ai-tools-for-lead-follow-up/
Time to connect the tools: about an hour. Difficulty: Easy.

Tools:
- HubSpot: Holds every lead and sends follow-up sequences. Setup 30 min, Easy. Starting price: $20/seat/mo.
- Zapier: Pushes new leads from forms into HubSpot. Setup 20 min, Easy. Starting price: $19.99/mo. Free plan available.
- ChatGPT: Drafts personal follow-up emails in seconds. Setup 5 min, Easy. Starting price: $20/mo. Free plan available.

Setup steps:
1. Create a free HubSpot account and import your lead list.
2. Connect your web form to HubSpot with a Zapier zap.
3. Write a 3-email follow-up sequence with ChatGPT, then load it into HubSpot.

How each AI assistant handles this task:
- Claude: Drafts personal follow-ups from lead notes and pulls them into HubSpot through Zapier MCP. Add-ons: Zapier MCP, HubSpot.
- Google Gemini: Drafts replies right in Gmail and logs leads in Sheets. Add-ons: Google Workspace, HubSpot.
- Grok Bot: Runs a routine that checks new leads every few minutes and drafts the first reply in your CRM. Add-ons: Grok Bot routines, HubSpot.
- ChatGPT: Writes follow-up messages you paste or send with a Zap. Add-ons: Zapier, HubSpot.

## Best AI tools for real estate lead follow-up
URL: https://aitoolsforowners.com/best-ai-tools-for-real-estate-leads/
Time to connect the tools: 2 to 3 hours. Difficulty: Medium.

Tools:
- Follow Up Boss: Pulls in portal leads and starts follow-up right away. Setup 1 hr, Medium. Starting price: not published as a simple monthly price; check the official site.
- Grok Bot: Watches new leads in Follow Up Boss and your inbox, drafts first replies, and runs daily routines like expired listing scans. Setup 1 hr, Medium. Starting price: not published as a simple monthly price; check the official site.
- Calendly: Lets buyers book showings on their own. Setup 15 min, Easy. Starting price: $12/seat/mo. Free plan available.
- ChatGPT: Writes listing descriptions and text replies. Setup 5 min, Easy. Starting price: $20/mo. Free plan available.

Setup steps:
1. Connect your lead sources to Follow Up Boss.
2. Turn on an action plan for new leads.
3. Add your Calendly link to every first reply.
4. Set up a Grok Bot with our free templates to draft first replies and run daily lead routines. Review every client message before it goes out.

How each AI assistant handles this task:
- Claude: Writes first replies and listing copy that sound like you. Add-ons: Zapier MCP, Follow Up Boss.
- Google Gemini: Drafts replies in Gmail and books showings on Google Calendar. Add-ons: Google Workspace, Calendly.
- Grok Bot: Watches Follow Up Boss and Zillow lead emails and drafts first replies within minutes, plus daily expired and FSBO scans. Add-ons: Grok Bot routines, Follow Up Boss.
- ChatGPT: Writes listing descriptions and text replies. Add-ons: Zapier, Follow Up Boss.

## Best AI tools for invoicing
URL: https://aitoolsforowners.com/best-ai-tools-for-invoicing/
Time to connect the tools: 1 to 2 hours. Difficulty: Medium.

Tools:
- QuickBooks Online: Sends invoices and automatic payment reminders. Setup 45 min, Easy. Starting price: $38/mo.
- Zapier: Creates an invoice when a deal closes or a job is done. Setup 20 min, Medium. Starting price: $19.99/mo. Free plan available.
- Dext: Reads receipts so your books stay up to date. Setup 20 min, Easy. Starting price: not published as a simple monthly price; check the official site.

Setup steps:
1. Set up QuickBooks with your logo and payment terms.
2. Turn on automatic reminders for late invoices.
3. Build a zap that creates an invoice when a job is marked done.

How each AI assistant handles this task:
- Claude: Drafts polite payment reminders and checks invoice wording. Add-ons: Zapier MCP, QuickBooks.
- Google Gemini: Builds invoice trackers in Sheets and drafts reminders in Gmail. Add-ons: Google Workspace, QuickBooks.
- Grok Bot: Checks for overdue invoices on a schedule and drafts reminders for you to approve. Add-ons: Grok Bot routines, QuickBooks.
- ChatGPT: Drafts reminder emails and invoice notes. Add-ons: Zapier, QuickBooks.

## Best AI tools for bookkeeping and expenses
URL: https://aitoolsforowners.com/best-ai-tools-for-bookkeeping/
Time to connect the tools: 2 to 3 hours. Difficulty: Medium.

Tools:
- Xero: Keeps your books with bank feeds that match transactions. Setup 1 hr, Medium. Starting price: not published as a simple monthly price; check the official site.
- Dext: Snaps receipts and sends them to Xero. Setup 20 min, Easy. Starting price: not published as a simple monthly price; check the official site.
- Claude: Explains reports and drafts notes for your accountant. Setup 5 min, Easy. Starting price: $20/mo. Free plan available.
- Grok Bot: Sorts receipts from email, chases unpaid invoices, and drafts monthly expense summaries for your bookkeeper. Setup 1 hr, Medium. Starting price: not published as a simple monthly price; check the official site.

Setup steps:
1. Connect your bank accounts to Xero.
2. Link Dext and forward receipts to your Dext email.
3. Once a month, paste your profit and loss into Claude and ask what changed.
4. Set up a Grok Bot with our free bookkeeping templates. Have a professional review anything financial.

How each AI assistant handles this task:
- Claude: Explains your reports in plain words and drafts notes for your accountant. Add-ons: Zapier MCP, Xero, Dext.
- Google Gemini: Pulls receipts from Gmail into Sheets and sums expenses. Add-ons: Google Workspace, Dext.
- Grok Bot: Sorts receipts from email, suggests categories and drafts monthly summaries for review. Add-ons: Grok Bot routines, Xero or QuickBooks.
- ChatGPT: Answers bookkeeping questions and summarizes exported reports. Add-ons: Zapier, Xero.

## Best AI tools for scheduling appointments
URL: https://aitoolsforowners.com/best-ai-tools-for-scheduling/
Time to connect the tools: about an hour. Difficulty: Easy.

Tools:
- Calendly: Clients book open slots without back and forth. Setup 15 min, Easy. Starting price: $12/seat/mo. Free plan available.
- Zapier: Adds new bookings to your CRM or spreadsheet. Setup 15 min, Easy. Starting price: $19.99/mo. Free plan available.
- Reclaim.ai: Protects focus time around your meetings. Setup 15 min, Easy. Starting price: not published as a simple monthly price; check the official site.

Setup steps:
1. Create a Calendly event type for each service.
2. Turn on email and text reminders to cut no-shows.
3. Add a zap that logs each booking.

How each AI assistant handles this task:
- Claude: Drafts scheduling replies and agendas. Add-ons: Zapier MCP, Calendly.
- Google Gemini: Works inside Google Calendar and Gmail to suggest times. Add-ons: Google Workspace, Calendly.
- Grok Bot: Handles back and forth over email and creates events once you approve. Add-ons: Grok Bot routines, Calendly.
- ChatGPT: Drafts scheduling messages. Add-ons: Zapier, Calendly.

Tools:

- ChatGPT: Writes a month of captions from one prompt. Setup 10 min, Easy. Starting price: $20/mo. Free plan available.
- Buffer: Schedules posts to every network at once. Setup 15 min, Easy. Starting price: not published as a simple monthly price; check the official site.

Setup steps:
1. Set up a Canva brand kit with your colors and logo.
2. Ask ChatGPT for 20 captions based on your services.
3. Load posts into Buffer and schedule a month ahead.

How each AI assistant handles this task:
- Claude: Writes captions in your voice from a few notes. Add-ons: Canva, Buffer.
- Google Gemini: Drafts posts in Docs and finds images in Drive. Add-ons: Google Workspace, Canva.
- Grok Bot: Drafts a week of posts on a schedule and saves them in your scheduler for review. Add-ons: Grok Bot routines, Buffer, Canva.
- ChatGPT: Writes captions and makes simple images. Add-ons: Canva, Buffer.

## Best AI tools for customer support emails
URL: https://aitoolsforowners.com/best-ai-tools-for-customer-support-email/
Time to connect the tools: 1 to 2 hours. Difficulty: Medium.

Tools:
- Help Scout: Shared inbox with saved replies and a help center. Setup 1 hr, Easy. Starting price: not published as a simple monthly price; check the official site.
- Claude: Drafts replies to tricky emails in your tone. Setup 5 min, Easy. Starting price: $20/mo. Free plan available.
- Zapier: Routes urgent emails to your phone. Setup 20 min, Medium. Starting price: $19.99/mo. Free plan available.

Setup steps:
1. Move your support address into Help Scout.
2. Write saved replies for your top 10 questions.
3. Use Claude to draft answers to anything new.

How each AI assistant handles this task:
- Claude: Drafts careful, friendly replies from your help docs. Add-ons: Zapier MCP, Help Scout.
- Google Gemini: Drafts replies inside Gmail with Gemini. Add-ons: Google Workspace, Help Scout.
- Grok Bot: Triages the inbox twice a day and drafts replies to common questions. Add-ons: Grok Bot routines, Help Scout.
- ChatGPT: Drafts replies you paste into your help desk. Add-ons: Zapier, Help Scout.

URL: https://aitoolsforowners.com/best-ai-tools-for-meeting-notes/
Time to connect the tools: about 30 minutes. Difficulty: Medium.

Tools:
- Fireflies.ai: Joins calls and writes notes and action items. Setup 10 min, Easy. Starting price: $18/seat/mo. Free plan available.
- Otter.ai: Transcribes in person and online meetings. Setup 10 min, Easy. Starting price: $16.99/user/mo. Free plan available.
- Zapier: Sends summaries to your CRM or Slack. Setup 15 min, Medium. Starting price: $19.99/mo. Free plan available.

Setup steps:
1. Connect Fireflies to your calendar.
2. Pick which meetings it should join.
3. Send action items to your task list with Zapier.

How each AI assistant handles this task:
- Claude: Turns long transcripts into clear notes and action items. Add-ons: Fireflies, Zapier MCP.
- Google Gemini: Takes notes in Google Meet and saves them to Docs. Add-ons: Google Workspace, Fireflies.
- Grok Bot: Collects transcripts after meetings and sends action items to your task list. Add-ons: Grok Bot routines, Fireflies.
- ChatGPT: Summarizes transcripts you paste. Add-ons: Otter, Zapier.

- Zapier: Creates a proposal when a deal moves stages. Setup 30 min, Medium. Starting price: $19.99/mo. Free plan available.

Setup steps:
1. Build one proposal template in PandaDoc.
2. Paste call notes into Claude to draft the scope.
3. Automate the proposal from your CRM with Zapier.

How each AI assistant handles this task:
- Claude: Drafts proposals and reads contracts closely. Have a lawyer review legal terms. Add-ons: PandaDoc, Zapier MCP.
- Google Gemini: Builds proposals in Google Docs from a template. Add-ons: Google Workspace, PandaDoc.
- Grok Bot: Builds a draft proposal from your notes and CRM and saves it to PandaDoc for review. Add-ons: Grok Bot routines, PandaDoc.
- ChatGPT: Drafts proposal sections. Add-ons: PandaDoc, Zapier.

## Best AI tools for writing blog posts and marketing copy
URL: https://aitoolsforowners.com/best-ai-tools-for-writing-content/
Time to connect the tools: about 30 minutes. Difficulty: Easy.

Tools:
- Claude: Drafts long posts in a natural voice. Setup 5 min, Easy. Starting price: $20/mo. Free plan available.
- Grammarly: Cleans up grammar and tone. Setup 5 min, Easy. Starting price: not published as a simple monthly price; check the official site.
- Canva: Adds images for each post. Setup 15 min, Easy. Starting price: $18/mo. Free plan available.

Setup steps:
1. Give Claude 3 examples of your writing as a style guide.
2. Draft one post a week from a short outline.
3. Run it through Grammarly and add a Canva image.

How each AI assistant handles this task:
- Claude: Writes long, natural posts and edits drafts well. Add-ons: Grammarly, Canva.
- Google Gemini: Writes in Google Docs with your files as context. Add-ons: Google Workspace, Canva.
- Grok Bot: Researches and drafts posts on a schedule and saves them to your docs. Add-ons: Grok Bot routines, Canva.
- ChatGPT: Writes drafts and outlines. Add-ons: Grammarly, Canva.

## Best AI tools for payroll
URL: https://aitoolsforowners.com/best-ai-tools-for-payroll/
Time to connect the tools: 1 to 2 hours. Difficulty: Medium.

Tools:
- Gusto: Runs payroll and files payroll taxes. Setup 1 hr, Medium. Starting price: not published as a simple monthly price; check the official site.
- QuickBooks Online: Syncs payroll costs to your books. Setup 20 min, Easy. Starting price: $38/mo.
- Zapier: Sends payday reminders to your team. Setup 10 min, Easy. Starting price: $19.99/mo. Free plan available.

Setup steps:
1. Add your team to Gusto.
2. Connect Gusto to QuickBooks.
3. Set payroll to run on autopilot.

How each AI assistant handles this task:
- Claude: Explains payroll reports and drafts staff notes. Have a professional check anything financial. Add-ons: Gusto, Zapier MCP.
- Google Gemini: Tracks hours in Sheets and drafts notes in Gmail. Add-ons: Google Workspace, Gusto.
- Grok Bot: Reminds you of payroll deadlines and collects timesheets for review. Add-ons: Grok Bot routines, Gusto.
- ChatGPT: Answers payroll questions in general terms. Add-ons: Gusto, Zapier.
